description: onsemi BAT54SLT1G — dual series Schottky diode, 30V reverse, 200mA forward, Vf=320mV at 1mA / 800mV at 100mA. SOT-23-3 package. Common applications: reverse-polarity protection, signal clamping, OR-ing power supplies, and boost converter bootstrap.
name: bat54s
watch_out_for: Dual series-connected (common cathode not common anode). Pin 1=A1, Pin 3=A2, Pin 2=common cathode. 30V reverse rating — not for >24V nominal rails. Leakage current increases with temperature (~2µA at 25°C, ~100µA at 75°C). SOT-23 marking: 'L1' or 'S4' depending on manufacturer.
